description: The orthogonal drawing pipeline of Hegemann and Wolff makes a complete orthogonal drawing from boxes and the edges between them. It assigns ports on the box sides, routes every edge short and with few bends, reduces crossings, and then nudges shared segments apart. Routes run on the orthogonal visibility graph, or on the sparser *channel graph* of the centre lines between boxes. Boxes stay in place by default; with full nudging they can move and grow to keep the separation. Use `draw` when you have a fixed box layout and want the whole drawing in one call.

papers.title: A Simple Pipeline for Orthogonal Graph Drawing
papers.venue: Graph Drawing and Network Visualization (GD 2023), LNCS
